payload.block_text: In 2003, the BCBS, International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS), and IOSCO published a joint note detailing initiatives to combat AML/CFT. The note provided an overview of common AML/CFT standards across the three sectors and assessed gaps or inconsistencies in approaches. It also examined the relationships between institutions and their customers, focusing on vulnerable products or services.
